label: Eraser
intent: The eraser rubs the line out. Light: the eraser presses down onto the line with a stop, sweeps left 11 units in one pass while the line disappears under it, and lifts off at the far end, leaving the short line (v1's end state). Strong: it lifts first, slams down with a bounce, scrubs back and forth in three decaying strokes as it travels, and lifts off with a small hop. The erased length never grows back; the reverse slides it back while the line redraws.

band.//: v1's sleeve line; in Solid it is the slot in the block, so it draws nothing there

block.//: v1 Solid: the block filled with the sleeve slot left open, one bridged subpath

eraser.//: the travel along the line and the press onto it

rub.//: the scrub strokes, on top of the travel

eraser.x.//: monotonic: the line's erased end tracks it

line.draw.//: the right end follows the eraser: 26 -> 13.5 (v1's end state, 8 / 20.5 of the line); same keys as eraser.x, never grows back
